# SCOPEC

> SCOPEC (Supply Chain Operations Planning & Execution in Commodities) is a supply chain operations planning and execution tool for commodities. One planning kernel runs S&OP and S&OE on the same data model, and commodity families live in domain profiles as data, not code - soft commodities first, hard commodities next.

In development, about 20%. Built in public by Aleks Sidorecs as part of Automatiqa Lab, Apache-2.0. Physical planning only: hedging, mark-to-market and the trading book stay in the CTRM and enter as parameters and scenarios. Energy is out of scope.

## Docs

- [System schematic](https://github.com/automatiqa-lab/scopec/blob/main/docs/scopec-how-it-works-aleks-sidorecs.png): inputs, domain profile, planning kernel, two horizons, action ledger and glass box
